## Why this matters
PR #254 was merged to `main` on 2026-06-14 without closing its R81 audit findings. This issue tracks the outstanding follow-up work. Feature is behind `EXPO_PUBLIC_FF_ROMAN_THREE_ARC_ROUTER` (default-OFF) so there is no production blast radius today, but the PR is not R81-clean and cannot be flag-flipped until findings are closed.

## What's required
- [ ] **S1 (P2)** The BRIEF arc targets `SettingsStack > CoachBrief` which is only registered when independent `featureFlags.coachBrief` is true — flipping ED.2 alone with `coachBrief=false` produces a broken tap target — `src/screens/coach/CoachHomeScreen.tsx:290-305`; `src/navigation/CoachNavigator.tsx:392-400` — fix: gate the BRIEF arc/action on `featureFlags.coachBrief`, or register `CoachBrief` whenever `romanThreeArcRouter` is enabled, or target an always-registered route; add static matrix test for `romanThreeArcRouter=true && coachBrief=false`
- [ ] **S2 (P2)** Query errors and contract drift render as valid zero rings — `dailyRingsQuery.error`/`isError` ignored; failures flow into `rings={undefined}` which renders `0/0` counts as if backend returned zero work — `src/screens/coach/CoachHomeScreen.tsx:60-64,290-305`; `src/components/coach/CoachThreeArcRouter.tsx:59-65,162-198` — fix: add explicit error state props to `CoachThreeArcRouter`; render distinct loading/error/degraded state; at minimum hide/show "Counts unavailable" when `dailyRingsQuery.isError`; add tests for network/contract/403 failures not rendering as valid zero-count rings
- [ ] **F1 (P3)** Hook docstring claims "Polled on Coach Home focus" but no focus-refresh mechanism exists — `src/hooks/useCoachThreeArcCounts.ts:4-6` — fix: correct the stale docstring or implement real focus-window invalidation
- [ ] **F2 (P3)** `CoachThreeArcRouter` hardcodes `accessibilityState={{ busy: false }}` with no `isLoading` prop wired — `src/components/coach/CoachThreeArcRouter.tsx:203-207`; `src/screens/coach/CoachHomeScreen.tsx:296-303` — fix: wire the `busy` state to the actual loading state, or remove the misleading summary-level `accessibilityState`

## Already resolved
Pre-merge audit + post-merge re-audit complete. Findings list above is verified against current `main`.
